meta.name: context-engineering
meta.description: Designing what information goes into the context window and in what order.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计提示词上下文的内容与顺序
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要优化AI模型的输入上下文以提升输出质量。
copy.tagline_en: Design the content and order of context for prompts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to optimize the input context for AI models to improve output quality.

howto.what: Claude 会根据上下文工程原则，自动管理令牌预算，将最重要的指令放在开头，用户输入放在末尾，并使用摘要、优先级历史等策略优化信息架构，提升输出相关性。
howto.when: 当对话上下文接近令牌限制，或用户提供大量文档、复杂指令时，Claude 会主动应用上下文工程策略来优化信息和顺序。

say.text: 请帮我整理当前上下文，优先保留最近的重要信息。
say.note: Claude 会压缩旧内容，释放空间。

say.text: 把最重要的文档放在回答前面。

howto.what_en: Claude proactively manages the context budget, places critical instructions at the beginning and user input at the end, and applies strategies like summarization and prioritized history to improve output relevance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the conversation context approaches token limits, or when the user provides extensive documents or complex instructions.

say_en.text: Please restructure the current context, keeping the most recent important information first.
say_en.note: Claude compresses old content to free space.

say_en.text: Place the most important document right before my question.
